caption: Figure 2: AUTOSAR Signal Nomenclature The main purpose of FlexRay Transport Protocol is to perform a transfer of a message (I-PDU) that e.g. might or might not fit in a single FlexRay L-PDU. I-PDUs that do not fit into a single FlexRay L-PDU are segmented into multiple parts, where each can be transmitted in a FlexRay L-PDU. According to AUTOSAR basic software architecture, the FlexRay Transport Protocol provides methods for - Segmentation of data in transmit direction - Reassembling of data in receive direction - Control of data flow - Error detection in segmentation sessions

targets.why: Standardized transport protocol for diagnostics on FlexRay
